title: Customer subscriptions are no longer auto-expanded by default
summary: The subscriptions property on Customers is no longer included by default.

migrationNotes.text: Lets you optimize performance by not automatically including the subscriptions property on the Customer object. You can still expand the list of subscriptions, but Stripe recommends against it for performance reasons.

sources.quote: | [Customer subscriptions are no longer auto-expanded by default](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2020-08-27/deprecates-auto-expansion-customer-subscriptions.md) | Billing | Breaking | api |
The `subscriptions` property on `Customers` is no longer included by default.
